name: Dream #8
description:
She was a Dream by Hulki Okan Tabak

10 artworks from my Giger inspired AI creations and the original soundtrack Don't Mess With Her created for this Blueprint project.

Images are paired with the soundtrack and the soundtrack is divided in to 6 closely resembling sections where the middle 4 sections appear twice. Cover Preview audio bears the full composition.
